# Differential expression analysis

```{r}
# Load raw count matrix
x <- read.delim("./dataset.txt", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, header = TRUE)
DG <- readDGE(x , header = FALSE)

matrix <- DG$counts
matrix <- matrix[-(1:4), ]

group <- x$group
DG <- DGEList(matrix, group = group)
DG$samples$name <- x$description
DG$samples$batch <- x$batch

d <- DG
genes <- read.delim("./mm10_2020-A_star_geneInfo.tab", header = F)
genes <- genes[2:nrow(genes),]
colnames(genes) <- c("ENSBL", "GeneName", "Type")

data <- d$samples
data <- data[order(data$group),]
data$order <- as.numeric(c(1:nrow(data)))

levels <- c("PBS", "C26")
data$group <- factor(data$group, levels = levels)
data$lib.size <- (data$lib.size/1000000)
data$lib.size <- round(data$lib.size, digits = 2) 

# Design matrix
design <- model.matrix(~d$samples$group)

# Keep all genes that have value grater then 1 in at least 2 samples
keep <- rowSums(edgeR::cpm(d)> 1) >= 2 

d <- d[keep,]
# Replace lib size
d$samples$lib.size <- colSums(d$counts) 
d <- calcNormFactors(d, method = "TMM") 
logCPM <- edgeR::cpm(d, log = TRUE)

d$samples$group <- relevel(factor(d$samples$group), ref = "PBS")
design <- model.matrix(~d$samples$group + d$samples$batch)

colnames(design) <- c("PBS", "C26", "Batch")
head(design)

y <- estimateDisp(d, design)
fit <- glmQLFit(y,design)
lrt <- glmQLFTest(fit,coef=2)

lrt$table$FDR <- p.adjust(lrt$table$PValue, method = "BH")

degs <- lrt$table
degs$ENSBL= rownames(degs)

degs <- merge(degs, logCPM_PBS, by.x = "ENSBL", by.y = "GeneName", all.x = TRUE)
degs <- merge(degs, logCPM_C26, by.x = "ENSBL", by.y = "GeneName", all.x = TRUE)
degs$Diff058 <- ifelse(degs$FDR < 0.05 & degs$logFC > 0.58 & degs$logCPM_C26 > 5, "UP",
                          ifelse(degs$FDR < 0.05 & degs$logFC < -0.58  & degs$logCPM_PBS > 5,"DOWN",
                                 "noDiff")) 
degs <- merge(degs, genes, by.x = "ENSBL", by.y = "ENSBL", all = FALSE)

# Up regulated sites
up058 <- filter(degs, (degs$FDR < 0.05 & degs$logFC > 0.58 & degs$logCPM_C26 > 5))

# Down regulated sites
down058 <- filter(degs, (degs$FDR < 0.05 & degs$logFC < -0.58  & degs$logCPM_PBS > 5))
```
